remarks: Inspired by the grandeur and sculptural decoration of the Gilded Age this home is a celebration of artistic heritage and meticulous craftsmanship. Presenting a Masterpiece by Dinyar Wadia: A Georgian Colonial of Distinction. Professionally landscaped parklike property boasting specimen trees and plantings with identified site for pool & pool house. Step into a realm of timeless elegance with this one-of-a-kind Georgian colonial. Built to stand the test of time, constructed using steel, concrete, brick & slate. The intricate brickwork & gabled slate roof pay homage to an era of craftsmanship. Quality is paramount with premium materials gracing every surface. The high ceilings amplify the sense of well proportioned space & luxury. Be WOWED by the soaring front to back entry, formal living room, dining room and wood paneled office. A gourmet kitchen is a culinary haven with a sunlit breakfast nook that gracefully opens out to a serene patio courtyard. The 2nd floor features 5 gracious sized bedrooms with sumptuous en-suite bathrooms and walk in closets. There is an additional 3,300 SF in the LL, already outfitted with a full bathroom and gym. Transform the UFLL space to home theater, playroom & sports/rec space. A sun-drenched finished 3rd floor is currently used as play space & art studio. Simply the best of everything at 794 Oenoke Ridge.
